finalMessage:
VERDICT: PASS

| id | severity | file:line | issue | required change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | LOW | amendment:3 | The G01-23 clause "G01 updates governance references only; it does not approve or authorize PD-047…" is no longer in the Status line. The meaning survives at amendment:5, :784, :800 and decisions:2186. | Optionally add one clause to line 3 saying G01 and BE-7 are not an approval source. |
| F2 | LOW | tasks:1089, :1104, :1119 | Three sentences from the owner-approved cards (package §3) were dropped. They are "T082/T057/T085 are not prerequisites" (T083), "No ui-entry, prototype acceptance, final 1.5 acceptance… prerequisite" (T084) and "T085 does not depend on M4, T055, M1-done or pilot" (T085). The edges are still correct in the register (:44, :94, :45) and the manifest (amendment:439–466). | Restore the sentences so the cards match the approved text. |
| F3 | LOW | tasks:1086–1130 | T083–T085 have no `Readiness:` line, which the other cards carry (e.g. :120, :282). Blocked state is only in field 12 (:1098, :1113, :1128) and the summary (:19). | Add `Readiness: blocked …` lines. |
| F4 | LOW | tasks:1089 | The T083 prerequisites omit `PM-6-UI-entry`. The manifest (amendment:436) and the register (tasks:96) carry it. This is fail-closed, since it equals `ui-entry`. | Name `PM-6-UI-entry` on the card. |
| F5 | LOW | amendment:19, :724 | Stale text says adoption is pending ("Selection is recorded; adoption is pending… Until PD-047… approved and applied, PD-039… remain binding"). This contradicts amendment:3, :5 and :788. The :3 carve-out covers only §10 and §12. | Add a dated "superseded by adoption 2026-11-15" note. |
| F6 | LOW | tasks:3 vs :40, :282, :788, :1018 | Line 3 says feature-checklist run/disposition "is met". The register and the T010/T035/T048 Readiness lines still list "feature-checklist evidence" as a blocker. This is consistent only if it means T001's duty to record the run (register:74). | Reword the Readiness lines to say "T001 records the checklist run". |
| F7 | LOW | amendment:3, :706, :834; tasks:7; decisions:2190 | No document cites the 2026-11-15 15:47Z independent G01 PASS (`final.txt`). That PASS reviewed the five files before PD-047 adoption. BE-7 "open" is therefore unexplained. | On closing BE-7, record the 15:47Z PASS as historical and this delta review as the post-adoption evidence. |
| F8 | LOW | tasks:329, :592, :628, :648, :911, :965 | Readiness lines for T011, T026, T082, T027, T042 and T045 still name the retired `prototype` gate, which is now `ux-brief` (no register row). T027's Readiness also lists it, although the approved change removed UI gates from T027; its Prerequisites line (:652) is correct. Still blocked, so fail-closed. | Update the Readiness wording. |

**A. Governance meaning preserved: yes, with the F1 caveat.**
- **G01-19 (tasks:3).** It matches the manifest `new` text except one clause. "T001 (M1, feature-checklist)" became "T001/backend-entry; feature-checklist run/disposition is met by the separate BE-5 record below". Everything else is identical:
  - "Codex author checks are not an independent review verdict";
  - "No implementation/staging/commit/push/deploy authorization";
  - T080–T082 not Gate 2-approved.
- **G01-19 follow-on paragraphs (tasks:5, :7, :13).** They keep BE-7 as "G01 independent review… outstanding". Line 11 (G01-20) keeps the separate-session, enforced-read-only, no-self-review text and both final-verdict triggers.
- **Terminology.** `Fable` appears only as history (tasks:11, :1787; amendment:12 "no prospective role under G01").
- **G01-23 (amendment:3).** The line was rewritten because "not applied" became false after owner approval. It keeps:
  - "No implementation, staging, commit, push or deployment is authorized";
  - the independent review "remains an open gate";
  - BE-7 and T001 outstanding.

  The approval source is named as the owner, so nothing reads as G01 approving PD-047. The only loss is F1.
- **G01-24 (amendment:779–782).**
  - **Bullet 1.** It changed "every HIGH card" to "HIGH/CRITICAL work and this amendment". That is not narrower, and it matches AGENTS.md:179. It keeps separate session, enforced read-only and the two-round limit.
  - **Bullets 2–3.** They are byte-identical to the manifest, including the unresolved-disagreement and before-any-push triggers (AGENTS.md:199–200).
  - **Line 851.** It says publication review is "not currently triggered" because no push is requested, which is consistent.

**B. Approvals beyond the owner's records: none found.**
- **BE-5.** It is bounded to run/disposition (tasks:7; assessment:193–203; amendment:704 "met for run/disposition only"). All 82 markers stay unchecked and no ODs are resolved.
- **BE-7.** It is open everywhere: amendment:3, :706; tasks:7, :120; decisions:2190; assessment:207; package §8. No "BE-7 met" text appears.
- **T001.** Authorization is outstanding (tasks:120; assessment:208). BE-8 is unproduced.
- **T010/T035/T048.** They are blocked by T001/backend-entry (tasks:3, :282, :788, :1018; register :40).
- **FP-003.** It stays unauthorized (decisions:2186; amendment:777, :849).
- **Branding.** T080–T082 are excluded (tasks:3, :5, :25; amendment:718, :778). T080 gets T001 as an entry-evidence edge only (tasks:317).
- **Direction of drift.** The residual drift (F5, F6, F8) understates approval rather than overstating it.
- **tasks:3 and T083–T085 content approval.** Line 3 still says "all other cards… blocked structure only". Line 5 records the T083–T085 content approval, which is consistent with the package.

**C. T083–T085: consistent with PD-047 items 1, 3 and 4, free of hidden approvals, and still blocked.**
- **T084 comes before `ui-entry`.** Its prerequisites are T002 and G-IMPLEMENT only (tasks:1104; manifest amendment:439–445). Its invariant says it is "before and independent of ui-entry" (:1107), and register :44 calls it "a predecessor, not a consumer". The UI cards depend on T084 (:333, :596, :632, :915, :969).
- **T085 is staging UX acceptance** (:1116–1128). Its prerequisites match the manifest (:1119 vs amendment:447–465). They exclude M4, T055, M1-done and pilot, and all thresholds are unchanged. T055 (:1192) and T056 (:1209) take M4, T085, M1-done and M-01-M5 downstream.
- **Roadmap 1.3(b), 1.4(b) and 1.5 are completion evidence.** They are not in any T083/T084 prerequisite list (decisions:2183). T083 acceptance (:1095) says no local result closes them. Register :45 puts M1-done on T056.
- **No pure-helper bypass of M1-B.** T010, T035, T048, T079 and T058 all trace to T001 (:286, :792, :1022, :303, :1243; decisions:2182).
- **Still blocked.** All three cards declare `Executor class: blocked` (:1098, :1113, :1128). The summary is 0 ready / 85 blocked (:19).
- **Open items.** See F2–F4 above.

**D. Contradictions: none on BE-7, T001, BE-8 or the G01 review gate.** The sources agree: BE-7 open, T001 unauthorized, BE-8 unproduced, G01 review separate from PD-047's review evidence. The residual inconsistencies are F5–F8. F7 matters most for provenance: `final.txt` records a G01 PASS, while the docs say only "five-file comparison passed" and "independent review open".

**Scope limits:** I reviewed only the frozen pre-G02 snapshot. I did not verify the `.sha256` hashes, re-run the G01 byte-replay, or run any tests. This verdict is review evidence only. It does not close BE-7 as an owner gate, authorize T001, or approve anything.

INDEPENDENCE: this session authored none of the reviewed material and ran read-only.
